review_notes: The July 23 datelined report says the Khimti-Those road had been affected since Monday by the Bhittari landslide; that Monday was 2016-07-18.
The slide is explicitly at Kapurkot Rural Municipality-3 on the Dang-Salyan road; Kapurkot is in Salyan, while Dang is only the adjoining road corridor.
The Lidi/Jugal-2 landslide occurred Friday morning, 2020-08-14; the supplied August 15 article is a casualty update.
The August 3 recovery reports state the Rese/Dharche-5 landslide occurred the previous Sunday, 2024-07-28. All five initially missing people were subsequently recovered dead.
The Tuin Khola failure is on the Narayangadh-Muglin road section in Chitwan; Tanahu appears only in the alternative-route discussion.
The relief article explicitly says the Khole Sabang, Taman Khola-2 house landslide occurred on Shrawan 12, 2077, corresponding to 2020-07-27, and killed two children.
The September 2 report says the road had been blocked since the previous Sunday by a slide at Guinthe, Dana, Annapurna-3; that Sunday was 2021-08-29.
The fatal house landslide is explicitly at Uppallo Gohore in Siranchok Rural Municipality-7; Aarughat refers to a separate stream-rescue story in the same article.
The July 27 report says the dry landslide near Badali, Mahakali Municipality-2 occurred Friday, establishing 2020-07-24; Naugad is the victim's home municipality.
The August 15 report states it had been 12 days since landslide debris blocked Iku in Bhotekoshi-2, supporting 2025-08-03 as the failure date.
The source explicitly dates the Doramba Shailung-3 Lekharka landslide to Bhadau 9, Sunday 2024-08-25, and reports eight confirmed deaths by the update.
The July 26 report states the Kodari Highway had been fully blocked by the landslide for 10 days, supporting 2026-07-16 rather than the publication date.
The blast-triggered rock/landslide occurred at Palata on the Karnali Corridor in Kalikot; Kathmandu is only the publisher location.
The Lidi landslide occurred Friday morning, 2020-08-14. This August 17 follow-up states that 19 bodies had been recovered at that point; 50 is not the reported death count.
The Gaumukhi-4 house-burying landslide is stated to have occurred Tuesday around midnight; the article was published Wednesday 2018-08-15.
The August 23 report explicitly says the Hungung/Koshi Highway landslide occurred Thursday, 2025-08-21 and had blocked the road for three days.
The Daunne/Ghiukhola failure is in Binayi Triveni-2, Nawalparasi (Bardaghat Susta East), canonically Nawalpur. Police explicitly reported no human casualties.
The September 30 body-transfer article states that all six ANFA students died in the Sisneri landslide on Saturday, 2024-09-28.
The Daunne dry landslide is explicitly at Binayi Triveni Rural Municipality-2 in Nawalparasi (Bardaghat Susta East), canonically Nawalpur, not Parasi.
The July 8 article says the Setidobhan landslide had blocked the Narayangadh-Muglin road since Wednesday night, establishing 2021-07-07.
The July 9 report states the Malika-3 Lupshitar landslide occurred Wednesday afternoon at about noon; in 2025 that date is 2025-07-09.
